items.title: Charles Lloyd — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Somebody told me later on he had been a Shakespearian actor.

ctx.x: And he used to strut around with minimal clothes on. Like some old short pants and he had a body like gladiator - Roman style. He had a perfect, beautiful body. And all those little girls down in the village, they were like, “Big Brown, oh man!” And so this little Italian boys in the village got mad, and they was gonna take him off. So he whooped about five or six of them at once, and somebody said he had been a boxer and this and that. And then they said something deep. Somebody told me later on he had been a…
